creditsPerUsage.label: {{currency}} per usage
creditsPerUsage.description: This amount will be deducted once per usage.

creditsPerMinute.label: {{currency}} per minute
creditsPerMinute.description: This amount will be deducted per minute of the session duration.

creditsPerOperatingMinute.label: {{currency}} per operating minute
creditsPerOperatingMinute.description: This amount will be deducted per minute attributed to machine operation.

meterRate.label: per measured value ({{currency}})
meterRate.description: 0 disables billing. The rate is captured when a session starts.
meterRate.invalid: Enter a valid price with up to {{digits}} decimal places.

description.shared: Every start and stop of a session closes a time segment. The consumption of that segment is split equally between the sessions active in it.
description.per-session: A flow measures every session separately via its own measuring point. Nothing is split.

projectSwitchCharging.label: Charging on project switch
projectSwitchCharging.description: How a running session is charged when its owner switches to another project. Each project is billed for its own part.

descriptions.continue: No new fee per usage. Minutes are rounded across all parts, so together they cost no more than one session without a switch.
descriptions.continue-per-part-rounding: No new fee per usage. Every part rounds up its own minutes, so each switch can add one minute.
descriptions.new-session: Every part is billed like a new session: fee per usage, its own rounding and a balance check before the switch.

toast.title: Billing updated
toast.description: The usage-based billing has been updated successfully.
